script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for March 14. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.
Every living thing on Earth—every plant, animal, bacterium, and you—is built on carbon.  This single element forms the backbone of DNA, proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.  Life is carbon-based.

Carbon can form four chemical bonds—more than almost any element. It can bond to itself in long chains, rings, and branches. This creates millions of possible molecules. Carbon's superpower is versatility. The carbon in your body has been recycling through Earth's systems for billions of years.  It was forged in stars, drifted through space, became part of ancient seas and creatures.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: Versatility is power.  Carbon teaches that the ability to connect in many ways—to form diverse bonds and structures—creates infinite possibilities.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Connection Diversity - Build More Bonds.

Here's your activity: Carbon's power is forming diverse bonds. Where in your life could you connect more diversely—new types of relationships, skills, or experiences? Identify one new type of connection you could cultivate this month. This helps you increase versatility through diverse connections.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about carbon is everywhere can be applied to connection diversity - build more bonds. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
